mapper.select: SELECT order_id, order_number, order_type, total_price, order_status, created_at FROM orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT iN('결제대기', '취소') ORDER BY order_id DESC
SELECT order_id, order_number, order_type, total_price, order_status, created_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, m.menu_name AS menuName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS unitPrice, o.option_id AS optionId, o.option_name AS optionName, o.option_price AS optionPrice FROM order_items oi
JOIN menus m ON m.menu_id = oi.menu_id
LEFT JOIN order_item_options oio ON oio.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN options o ON o.option_id = oio.option_id
WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
